description: This file appears to be an HTML document that integrates the CodeMirror code editor for syntax highlighting and editing of APL code. It includes embedded APL code examples in a textarea and sets up a CodeMirror instance with APL mode. The file also contains links to CSS styles and external scripts required for CodeMirror functionality.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor attached to the textarea element with id 'code', configuring it to display line numbers, match brackets, and use the APL mode for syntax highlighting.
